title: OSL Group joining the @Mastercard Crypto Partner Program further strengthens our focus on enterprise
content:
OSL Group joining the @Mastercard Crypto Partner Program further strengthens our focus on enterprise payment infrastructure.

As Leon Chua, Head of APAC & Vice President at OSL BizPay, highlighted, our focus is on helping businesses operate globally with compliant, real-time, programmable payments.

Through this collaboration, we look forward to advancing stablecoin-powered payment solutions designed for real-world enterprise needs.
author: @osldotcom

title: OSL Group’s participation in the @Mastercard Crypto Partner Program marks another step in building t
content:
OSL Group’s participation in the @Mastercard Crypto Partner Program marks another step in building trusted, compliant, and scalable digital asset infrastructure.

As Kevin Cui, Executive Director & Chief Executive Officer at OSL Group, highlighted, OSL’s institutional-grade stablecoin solutions and Mastercard’s global partner network can help bring stablecoins closer to mainstream financial use cases.

content:
TradFi trust meets Web3 efficiency. 🤝

We are incredibly proud to announce that OSL Group has joined the @Mastercard Crypto Partner Program!

OSL is scaling compliant stablecoin infrastructure via #OSLBizPay, #StableHub and  @BanxaOfficial to enable real-time, borderless B2B payments. 🌍⚡️

We look forward to collaborating with Mastercard and its ecosystem of partners on the co-creation of innovative payment use cases and pilot initiatives leveraging stablecoin infrastructure.
